description: This file defines a Java class 'PayrollSystemAdapter' that implements the 'PayrollSystemPort' interface. It is responsible for sending employee information to an external payroll system via JMS messaging, utilizing Spring's JmsTemplate for message handling. The class also makes use of SLF4J for logging and adheres to dependency injection patterns typical in Spring applications.

classes.name: PayrollSystemAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component that acts as an adapter to send employee info messages to an external payroll system via JMS.

methods.name: sendEmployeeInfo
methods.description: Sends employee details as a JMS message to an external payroll system, setting relevant message properties.

methods.name: sendEmployeeInfo
methods.description: Sends employee information as a JMS message with specific properties set, including correlation ID, delivery mode, message ID, priority, and expiration.
